flows.title: Create, rename or delete a folder in Plaud Web
steps: Plaud Web's file library is behind sign-in: signed out, web.plaud.ai opens its sign-in page instead, and every step below is on the library it shows once you are signed in.
To create a folder, click the + icon to the right of your folders list.
Enter a name for the new folder, then click Save to confirm.
To rename or delete a folder, find it, click the ... icon to the right of its name, and select Edit or Delete from the menu that appears.
A deleted folder cannot be restored. The files inside it move to Trash, where they can be restored later.

flows.title: Export a recording, transcript, summary or mind map from Plaud Web
steps: These steps are on Plaud Web once you are signed in; signed out, web.plaud.ai opens its sign-in page instead.
Open the file you want to export.
Click the Share icon in the top-right corner.
Choose the content you want to export: the audio, the transcript, the summary or the mind map.
Select the file format. Audio exports as MP3; a transcript as TXT, SRT, DOCX or PDF; a summary as TXT, Markdown, DOCX or PDF; a mind map as PNG or Markdown.
For a transcript, choose whether to include timestamps and speaker labels.
